text: Security is a crucial part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through passwords or two-factor methods. Input validation is also essential, because it stops harmful data from entering the system. Developers must understand common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and learn how to prevent them. By focusing on these areas, developers can build safer websites and protect users from online threats.
